notes_for_editor: Thin record. No visit report, staffing record or fire history was available: the register page has no visit section, and the FFLA list gives only the status 'Standing'. The NRHP nomination text could not be read (NARA PDF returned 403). Search snippets of the nomination, which I could not quote, give conflicting figures: about 45 ft Aermotor HC-40 with a 7 ft cab in one, and 99 ft Aermotor nC-40 with a 7 ft cab in another. Both differ from the register's 46 ft LX-25; this is unresolved and the story uses the register's figure. The proposed height correction (13.7 m to 14.0 m) assumes the register's 46 feet is the right figure. Leads not read: a Western News article of 2025-09-05 about volunteer restoration of historic Arizona lookouts (may cover this tower); a 1964 newspaper item describing a three-person fire-watch crew (historic staffing, snippet only). The Living New Deal page returned 403 and the weebly page for West Peak returned 404. Read budget: six reads, all used.
